nina: Quick thread to finalize internal RN + pin for rwd-infer@v2.6.2. Change window suggestion: 2026-03-29 19:00-20:00 UTC. Need pin + deploybot schedule.

nina: Draft RN (internal short):
- v2.6.2: serving runtime fixes
- KV-cache persistence improvements for reconnects
- p95/p99 tail latency reductions on long-sequence traffic
- new opt-in limit `max_tokens_per_request` to reduce OOMs
- DB: online, throttled index build on requests.created_at (per-shard)

nina: Rollback triggers proposed: sustained >=1% 5xx OR p95 >1.6x baseline for 10m OR QA eval drift >3%. Owners: @cal oncall, @rene infra, @mona comms.

cal: I'll take oncall. Request canary 5% for 15m, capture p95 + p99 traces and top-span traces. If p95 >1.6x or errors spike I'll flip fallback route and abort.

rene: Infra will run pre-rollout smoke at 18:30 UTC (disk headroom, per-shard throttling, autoscaler caps). I'll add migration throttles and pause low-priority jobs during rollout.

mona: Comms tweak: internal blast should say "no expected customer downtime; dedicated customers pinned to older minors unaffected" and include 3-step rollback play (abort canary, flip fallback, revert pin).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled 2026-03-29 19:05 UTC (5% traffic, 15m) -> ramp 25% at 19:25 UTC -> full rollout 19:40 UTC if canary passes. CLI: `deploybot release --env prod --version rwd-infer@v2.6.2 --canary 5%`.

notify-bot: notify-bot: Pin created in Console: rwd-infer@v2.6.2. Internal announce scheduled for 18:50 UTC.

nina: Final internal RN snippet for blast (ready):
"Rolling rollout of rwd-infer@v2.6.2 on 2026-03-29 19:00-20:00 UTC. No expected customer-visible downtime. DB migration: online throttled index build on requests.created_at (per-shard). Rollback triggers: >=1% 5xx, p95 latency >1.6x baseline for 10m, QA drift >3%. Owners: @cal oncall, @rene infra, @mona comms. Deploybot: `deploybot release --env prod --version rwd-infer@v2.6.2 --canary 5%`. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/dashboards/release-v2-6-2"
